item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. Your day's got a real shape to it — early morning grounding, midday check-ins, an afternoon pickup, evening wind-down. Eating fits into that shape too; it's not separate from it. With no notes logged today, don't let meals become the thing that slides while everything else gets scheduled. Action: before dinner tonight, pause and actually name what you ate today.
